## News

[
[Boral and SRG staff at Perth's Women and Babies Hospital during concrete pour]

### Perth teams pour it on for landmark hospital

Boral supplied 2,200m³ of Envirocrete for a major continuous concrete pour at Perth's new Women and
Babies Hospital, supporting this landmark healthcare infrastructure project in Western Australia.

arrow_forward
][102]
[
[Concrete footpath being finished with a broom]

### Order concrete online with the Boral Concrete App

Order concrete online in minutes with the Boral Concrete App. Get quotes, schedule delivery, pay
securely and track your order all in one place.

arrow_forward
][103]
[
[Old explosives storage building located near the quarry pit at Coldstream Quarry]

### A piece of history at Coldstream Quarry

Explore a 100-year-old explosives magazine at Boral’s Coldstream Quarry in Victoria and discover how
early quarrying practices were designed with safety in mind.

arrow_forward
][104]
[
[Boral employee Frank Lourey in PPE standing at quarry site]

### Boral's Frank Lourey selected as Institute of Quarrying Australia Ambassador

Boral Production Manager Frank Lourey has been selected as an Institute of Quarrying Australia
Ambassador for 2026, recognising his commitment to mentoring and industry leadership.

arrow_forward
][105]
[
[Tradie standing with Boral new plastic packaging]

### Boral transitions bagged dry mix products to recycled plastic packaging

Boral introduces innovative plastic packaging for cement products, improving durability, handling
and sustainability across construction projects in Australia.

arrow_forward
][106]
[
[Birds-eye view of powered lime on grey background]

### How Lime is Made from Limestone

Learn how limestone is transformed into quicklime and hydrated lime through the lime manufacturing
process. Discover how lime products are used across construction, water treatment, mining and
agriculture.

arrow_forward
][107]
[
[Wendy Purvis – Wellcamp Loader Driver & Plant Operator]

### From healthcare to quarrying: Wendy Purvis builds a new path at Wellcamp

Discover how Wendy Purvis transitioned from healthcare to a plant operator role at Boral’s Wellcamp
Quarry, building new skills and a career in quarrying.

arrow_forward
][108]
[
[Jordan from Boral with Peats Ridge Public School's new Defibrillator]

### Giving back at Peats Ridge

Boral’s Peats Ridge Quarry has donated a life-saving defibrillator to Peats Ridge Public School,
supporting community safety in a rural NSW region.

arrow_forward
][109]
[
[Tania O'Neill with colleague on site in PPE]

### Tania Neill on building lasting customer partnerships in Victoria

Learn how Boral’s Victorian Concrete Business Development Manager, Tania Neill, builds strong
customer partnerships to support major construction projects.

arrow_forward
][110]
[
[Photo of Henry Miller in PPE]

### Creating opportunities on Country: Henry’s story at Dundowran Quarry

Learn how Boral’s partnership with the Butchulla Native Title Aboriginal Corporation is creating
employment pathways on Country, including Henry’s journey at Dundowran Quarry.

# World Leaders in Delivering Constructive Solutions

A world leader in tailored constructive solutions for the construction industry, Fosroc is known for
developing, manufacturing, and supplying innovative solutions for more than 80 years – backed by
excellent technical support and expert customer service.

# Concrete Mix and Design Support

Operated by experts, this essential technical service helps ensure the use of the best admixture for
concrete mix design for every application while also providing tailor-made solutions that address
vital demands like strength, retention, durability, etc.

# On-site Application and Technical Support

Our team of experts are dedicated to on-site application assistance and are ready to tackle any
challenges as well as to support, guide, and train applicators to drive projects to successful
completion.

# Specification Support

We have a team of dedicated experts across the country, armed with the resources and expertise to
support the selection of the best products and systems with correct BOQ specifications and to enable
informed decision-making on materials fit for purpose.

# Fosroc Technology Centre

Our state-of-the-art Technology Centre in India develops the latest technology and innovative
product solutions to serve the needs of India and the global market.

# Channel Partners

Our channel partner network is widely spread across India for faster reach and service that can
support industry, infrastructure and building projects.

# Training and CSR

Aiming to contribute to organic economic and social growth, we play a pivotal role in the greater
scheme of development by supporting skill enhancement and essential industry-specific training.

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

# Inspiring people to build better

Master Builders Solutions is a leading global manufacturer of concrete technologies dedicated to
revolutionizing the construction industry with sustainable solutions that inspire people to build
better.

## Partnering for Growth

Growth doesn’t happen by accident. It is the result of shared ambition, unwavering belief, and the
dedication of the right people. Over the past 2.5 years, Master Builders Solutions has undergone a
rapid and successful transformation. Evolving and expanding into a strong, standalone business is a
journey that has been shaped by our team's deep industry expertise, bold strategic decisions, and a
partnership built on long-term conviction. Together with Cinven, we’ve focused on building for the
future: growing our team from 1,500 to 2,000 people, expanding to 43 sites worldwide, completing 4
acquisitions, launching new products and segments, and strengthening long-lasting customer
relationships. All while continuing to innovate to help the industry build better.

[Watch the video][15]

This year, our teams at Master Builders Solutions Group turned challenges into wins, pushing
boundaries and creating solutions that make construction smarter and more sustainable. We’ve

creativity, and passion made it all happen!

## [Fast Traffic Concrete Mix][68]

When you’ve got to get the job back open to traffic fast, there’s only one choice: Sakrete **Fast
Traffic Concrete Mix**. Formulated for rapid strength gain, this pro-grade mix is ready for traffic
3x times faster than standard concrete mixes.

Designed for demanding commercial applications, Sakrete Fast Traffic High Early Strength Concrete
Mix is ideal for high-use areas like transitions, ramps, or industrial drive lanes. Use for new
construction or repairs where application depth exceeds 2”. When project timelines are tight or
downtime is costly, this [advanced performance mix][69] keeps operations moving.

For jobs requiring extended working time, [Pro-Mix Advanced Concrete Mix][70] is a strong
alternative. Pair with [Sakrete Bonder & Fortifier][71] to further strengthen adhesion.

[View Product][72]
[ [Bag of Sakrete Pro-Mix All-Purpose Cement Mix for Fast Concrete Repairs] ][73]

## [Pro-Mix All-Purpose Cement Mix][74]

Sakrete **All-Purpose Cement Mix** is the most versatile concrete repair mix in the Pro-Mix
portfolio. Engineered for extreme speed, strength (9,000 PSI) and flexibility, this mix offers
extended working time so pros can achieve a quality finish on horizontal or vertical repairs.

This pre-mix concrete is ideal for tilt-up panels, precast repairs, curb edges, culverts and any job
requiring high strength from feather edge to deep fills. It’s a pro favorite for its adaptability
across substrates and applications.

For ultra-fast, [full-depth repairs][75], [Pro-Mix Accelerated][76] is another dependable choice.
For shaping overhead or detailed areas, [Pro-Mix Concrete Repair][77] offers superior workability.

DOT Approved in CA (Category 3 & 4), MT, AZ, NE, TX, MS, GA, FL, NC, NJ

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

### BaseTek specializes in the design and manufacture of quality precision mineral castings
### constructed of our environmentally friendly Zanite^{®} Plus mineral cast polymer composite.

### Typical Applications

#### [Machine Tools][43]

Typical applications include: high speed machining cells, turning centers, CNC knee mills, milling
machines, waterjet cutting machines, laser cutting machines, grinders and industrial measurement and
testing equipment.

#### [Pump and Rotating Equipment][44]

Typical applications include: non-metallic corrosion resistant baseplates for chemical and general
duty process pumps and related rotating equipment such as motors and compressors. Rigid and flat
(0.002” per foot) mounting surfaces speed and maintain alignment. Vibration damping extends
equipment reliability and service life.

#### [Metrology and Inspection][45]

Zanite^{® } Plus machines are able to withstand harsh production environments and give instant,
accurate results. Zanite^{®} Plus thermal stability, design flexibility, and virtually zero moisture
absorption rates help metrology equipment manufacturers achieve their goals.

#### [Nanotechnology][46]

Typical applications include ultra-precision machining, diamond turning, precision grinding
machines. The nanotechnology is used to produce optical lenses, mirrors, and other mechanical
components with sub-micron and nanometer surface finishes. Zanite^{® } Plus polymer composite offers
a precise and stable platform that offers vibration damping from both internal and external sources.

#### [Semiconductor][47]

Typical applications include: screen printing machines, wire and die bonding, wafer inspection and
testing, lithography, laser PCB drilling machines, pick and place machines, surface profilers, wafer
handling and storage, dicing machines, flip-chip, and dispensing equipment.

#### [Utility Housekeeping Pads][48]

Typical applications include custom dimensioned housekeeping pads to raise utility or
telecommunication cabinets and enclosures off the floor or ground to protect them from moisture and
allow for easy access. Stainless steel threaded holes can be cast to location providing a
noncorrosive, nonconductive, mounting pad for equipment. Custom housekeeping pads can be cast to for
any specific application and reduce onsite preparation and installation costs. Internal
reinforcement can be added for seismic pad applications. Zanite Plus polymer composite pads are
built to last and will outperform conventional concrete pads in every way.

#### [Semiconductor][47]

Typical applications include: screen printing machines, wire and die bonding, wafer inspection and
testing, lithography, laser PCB drilling machines, pick and place machines, surface profilers, wafer
handling and storage, dicing machines, flip-chip, and dispensing equipment.

#### [Utility Housekeeping Pads][48]

Typical applications include custom dimensioned housekeeping pads to raise utility or
telecommunication cabinets and enclosures off the floor or ground to protect them from moisture and
allow for easy access. Stainless steel threaded holes can be cast to location providing a
noncorrosive, nonconductive, mounting pad for equipment. Custom housekeeping pads can be cast to for
any specific application and reduce onsite preparation and installation costs. Internal
reinforcement can be added for seismic pad applications. Zanite Plus polymer composite pads are
built to last and will outperform conventional concrete pads in every way.

# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

laser solutions and photonics technologies designed to power the next generation of manufacturing

problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial

# Innovating Drug Delivery, Together

## ExtruPharm works with pharma and biotech innovators to design and manufacture advanced
## polymer-based drug delivery systems — from early concepts to clinical-ready prototypes and
## beyond.

[ Work With Us ][9]

## ExtruPharm Provides a Variety of Design and manufacturing Services

Our team brings together expertise in extrusion, injection molding, and custom polymer processing to
design, develop, and refine advanced drug delivery devices. Every project is approached with
precision and innovation to ensure that each device meets the most rigorous performance, quality
standards, and the demanding specifications of each client.

[[Research and development images of various drug delivery devices]][10]

### [Research and Development][11]

Prototype Development

[[manufacturing]][12]

### [Manufacturing Services][13]

From Prototypes to Scalable Processes

[[Analytical Services tech holding vials for analyzing]][14]

### [Analytical Services][15]

Turning Data Into Decisions

[ View all services ][16]

## Products & Applications

### Shaping the Future of Combination Devices

Our expertise extends across a wide range of device formats and materials. Whether your program
requires durability, bioresorbability, or unique geometries, ExtruPharm is positioned to deliver.

### Applications Include:
* Drug-eluting implants for sustained and long-acting release
* Parenteral and implantable devices for direct-to-target or systemic delivery
* Custom geometries including rods, tubes, films, co-extruded structures, and complex profiles
* Next-generation combination devices built with polymer science and process innovation at the core

### Materials We Work With:
* Bio-durable polymers such as EVA and TPU
* Bioresorbable polymers including PLA, PLGA, PCL, and more
* Customized material blends and advanced formulations

## Why Choose ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is built around flexibility, technical depth, and cost-effectiveness. We are an ideal
partner for pharmaceutical and biotech companies seeking innovative solutions without unnecessary
overhead.

### Cost-Effective Development

Our rates are typically a fraction of larger CDMOs, allowing you to conserve budget for clinical
manufacturing.

### IP Protection

You retain full ownership of your intellectual property. All work performed is yours to transfer,
scale, or commercialize without restrictions

### Scalable & Transferable

Every process we design is built to be transferable — whether to a GMP CDMO of your choosing or to
one of ExtruPharm’s strategic partners.

### Agile & Responsive

As a small, specialized company, we move quickly, provide direct access to experts, and adapt to
your program’s unique needs.

### Custom Solutions

From modifying processes to designing equipment, we go beyond off-the-shelf solutions to ensure your
project’s success

### Industry Connections

Our strong relationships with leading equipment and material suppliers give you access to the right
resources, at the right time.

## About ExtruPharm

ExtruPharm is a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) specializing in the
development of polymer-based drug delivery devices

Since 2018, we have been helping companies bring complex ideas to life through expertise in
extrusion technologies, injection molding, and custom device engineering. Our focus is on creating
drug-eluting implants, parenteral devices, and combination products that improve patient outcomes
through controlled drug release.

In 2025, ExtruPharm expanded into a new 5,500 sq. ft. R&D facility in Auburn, Massachusetts,
enabling us to deliver analytical support and scalable prototype manufacturing with seamless
pathways toward GMP production through tech transfer partnerships.

We work with clients of all sizes — from startups to established pharmaceutical companies and
Universities — to deliver innovative solutions that are flexible, cost-effective, and tailored to
your program’s needs.

Applying for a grant? ExtruPharm is ideally situated to help with flat-fee services to keep you in
budget and meeting your grant timelines and deliverables.

## Client Testimonials

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

Lehigh Hanson is now Heidelberg Materials. In North America, Heidelberg Materials is a leading
supplier of cement, aggregates, ready mixed concrete, and asphalt with more than 450 locations and
approximately 9,000 employees.

## Material To Build Our Future

We're dedicated to our goal to create sustainable value with industry-leading products and solutions
to satisfy the construction needs of our customers around the world. See how we are Building a
Better Future for our people, our customers, our communities and our shareholders.

# Interplastic Corporation

Interplastic Corporation is a specialty chemical company with headquarters in St. Paul, Minnesota.
The company focuses on the production and distribution of unsaturated polyester and vinyl ester
resins, gel coats, colorants, and putties for the composites and cast polymer industries.

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

#### High-Speed Rail Corridor

Our Heavy Civil Infrastructure business are building India’s first High-Speed Rail Corridor,
mandated to construct 237.1 km stretch MAHSR (Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail), C4 package
involving the construction of the viaducts, stations, major river bridges, depots, and other
auxiliary works, representing 46.6% of the total length making it longest amongst all the packages,
running elevated from Zaroli Village on the Maharashtra – Gujarat border to Vadodara Station through
4 stations at Vapi, Bilimora, Surat and Bharuch in Gujarat.

[Read More ][137]

#### Dhubri - Phulbari Bridge

A project of huge strategic relevance, our Heavy Civil Infrastructure business is building India’s
longest river bridge connecting Dhubri in Assam to Phulbari in Meghalaya over the river Brahmaputra
that will reduce the distance between the two States by 250 km and improve the connectivity of the
North Eastern States with the rest of the country.

[Read More ][138]

#### Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA)

We are at the forefront of the ambitious Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) project, a
greenfield airport that will serve as the Mumbai Metropolitan Region’s second international airport.

Unsere Sitzbänke aus Polymerbeton sind stabil wie Beton, haben aber eine völlig glatte, porenfreie

entfällt die Pflege. Verunreinigungen können einfach abgewischt werden.

Sie suchen nach kreativen Ideen für Outdoor-Möbel? Dann ist unser Produkt genau das Richtige.

## Eigenschaften einer wirklich wetterfesten Outdoor-Tischtennisplatte

Tischtennistische für den Outdoorbereich, die das ganze Jahr über draußen nutzbar sein sollen,
müssen wetterfest sein.
D.h. Staub, Schmutz und Feuchtigkeit dürfen ihnen nichts anhaben. Doch welche Modelle kommen für
einen dauerhaften Außeneinsatz in Schulen, Parks, Campingplätzen, Schwimmbädern oder auch für den
Privathaushalt wirklich in Frage?  Wir geben Antworten.

[Wichtige Infos zum Thema wetterfeste Outdoor - Tischtennistische][36]

## Maillith garantiert höchste Qualität und Langlebigkeit: Made in Germany.

Unsere Profession ist die Herstellung von Outdoor Sport- und Spielgeräten wie Tischtennistischen,
Kletterwänden, Kickertischen, Tenniswänden und Skateanlagen aus Polymerbeton. Das speziell für den
Aussenbereich entwickelte Material wird auch als Mineralguss bezeichnet. Produkte von Maillith
bewähren sich seit über 40 Jahren in Park- und Freizeitanlagen ebenso wie auf Schulhöfen, in
Freibädern oder auf Campingplätzen. Polymerbeton erfüllt erwiesenermaßen über Jahrzehnte größte
Ansprüche an Wetterbeständigkeit, Haltbarkeit und Verschleißarmut.
Alle weiteren Bauteile für die Montage unserer Polymerbeton-Produkte werden fast ausschließlich in
Europa produziert. Auch hier garantieren wir höchste Qualität.

## Eigenschaften einer wirklich wetterfesten Outdoor-Tischtennisplatte

Tischtennistische für den Outdoorbereich, die das ganze Jahr über draußen nutzbar sein sollen,
müssen wetterfest sein.
D.h. Staub, Schmutz und Feuchtigkeit dürfen ihnen nichts anhaben. Doch welche Modelle kommen für
einen dauerhaften Außeneinsatz in Schulen, Parks, Campingplätzen, Schwimmbädern oder auch für den
Privathaushalt wirklich in Frage?  Wir geben Antworten.

[Wichtige Infos zum Thema wetterfeste Outdoor - Tischtennistische][36]

## Maillith garantiert höchste Qualität und Langlebigkeit: Made in Germany.

Unsere Profession ist die Herstellung von Outdoor Sport- und Spielgeräten wie Tischtennistischen,
Kletterwänden, Kickertischen, Tenniswänden und Skateanlagen aus Polymerbeton. Das speziell für den
Aussenbereich entwickelte Material wird auch als Mineralguss bezeichnet. Produkte von Maillith
bewähren sich seit über 40 Jahren in Park- und Freizeitanlagen ebenso wie auf Schulhöfen, in
Freibädern oder auf Campingplätzen. Polymerbeton erfüllt erwiesenermaßen über Jahrzehnte größte
Ansprüche an Wetterbeständigkeit, Haltbarkeit und Verschleißarmut.
Alle weiteren Bauteile für die Montage unserer Polymerbeton-Produkte werden fast ausschließlich in
Europa produziert. Auch hier garantieren wir höchste Qualität.

## Economies are built at the execution layer, not the AI factory

The Problem

## Inference & compute are solved.
## Operations are not

Teams can run a model. What they cannot do reliably is discover, coordinate, observe, secure, and
broker agents across devices and multi-cloud in one runtime. That is the operationalization gap.

### Stuck at proof of concept

90% of AI pilots never reach production. The barrier is not the model or the compute. It is
everything that has to happen for agents to run reliably at scale.

### Agents arrived. The stack didn't

Containers, centralized choreography, security by firewall and VPN, cloud-first architectures and
CI/CD tools: app-era band-aids force-fit onto Agentix systems that behave differently by nature.

### More than models and GPUs

Where will your agents run? How do they discover and interact? What if there is no connectivity? How
do you avoid vendor lock-in? Intelligence and compute alone cannot answer these.

[Fay Arjomandi]

“An agent is not an application. An agent is an actor that arrived inside the building like a
person.”

**Fay Arjomandi**Founder and CEO
[Read the post →][44]
The solution

## mimOE closes the operationalization gap

One lightweight Operating Engine that makes any device a first-class node in your Agentic AI
(Agentix) network. Develop with any tools, embed mimOE, and agents discover, network, and execute
securely across the continuum, under your control.

Lightweight|Powerful|Versatile
**From PoC to production, one engine**The same 10 to 20 MB Operating Engine from first device to
full fleet. No rearchitecting at scale, no rebuild when hardware changes.
**Purpose-built for Agentix, not retrofitted**Discovery, choreography, zero-trust security, and
observability are engine properties, not custom integration bolted on from the app era.
**Operations answered out of the box**Where agents run, how they discover each other, what happens
offline, who controls execution: answered by one Operating Engine, with Sovereignty in Execution
preserved.
[Explore mimOE + Toolsets][45][Explore solution packs][46][Talk to us for consulting][47]

Таким образом, что такое квадрокоптер становится понятным– это летательный аппарат с четырьмя винтами. Винты помогают быть более устойчивым, чем вертолёт. Принцип работы винтов квадрокоптера аналогичен вертолёту, лопасти движутся навстречу друг другу и создают вихревое кольцо, которое помогает находиться в воздушном пространстве. Подробнее [**здесь**][155]. ## Дрон Что такое квадрокоптер мы разобрались. Но есть ещё разновидности беспилотников. Например, аппарат с шестью лопастями на самом деле называется [**гексакоптер**][156], а с восемью – октокоптер. Общее название для них — мультикоптер, правда с оговоркой на обязательное наличие более двух винтов. Самое популярное название — дрон. ## Производители дронов Производителей квадрокоптеров в мире насчитывается несколько десятков. Одни из самых популярных моделей дронов выпускают компании Dji Innovations, Syma. Они имеют обширную линейку как для профессионалов, так и для любителей. Не без внимания на мировом рынке существуют такие компании, как WLToys, JJRC, Walkera, Parrot, MJX.   На сайте mykvadrocopter.ru вы можете подобрать квадрокоптер по своим требованиям, так как нами написано более 200 обзоров, множество новостей и куча полезной информации. Таким образом, что такое квадрокоптер становится понятным– это летательный аппарат с четырьмя винтами. Винты помогают быть более устойчивым, чем вертолёт. Принцип работы винтов квадрокоптера аналогичен вертолёту, лопасти движутся навстречу друг другу и создают вихревое кольцо, которое помогает находиться в воздушном пространстве. Подробнее [**здесь**][155]. ## Дрон Что такое квадрокоптер мы разобрались. Но есть ещё разновидности беспилотников. Например, аппарат с шестью лопастями на самом деле называется [**гексакоптер**][156], а с восемью – октокоптер. Общее название для них — мультикоптер, правда с оговоркой на обязательное наличие более двух винтов. Самое популярное название — дрон. ## Производители дронов Производителей квадрокоптеров в мире насчитывается несколько десятков. Одни из самых популярных моделей дронов выпускают компании Dji Innovations, Syma. Они имеют обширную линейку как для профессионалов, так и для любителей. Не без внимания на мировом рынке существуют такие компании, как WLToys, JJRC, Walkera, Parrot, MJX.   На сайте mykvadrocopter.ru вы можете подобрать квадрокоптер по своим требованиям, так как нами написано более 200 обзоров, множество новостей и куча полезной информации. [Polymer Concrete Manholes]
[P3 Polymers Logo]

P3 Polymers uses next generation polymer science to solve centuries old problems. We manufacture
cost-effective, environmentally friendly, and long-lasting polymer concrete structures to modernize
our crumbling infrastructure and eliminate the need for costly maintenance and rehabilitation.

# The threats to Concrete Manholes

[Corroded Manhole Illustration]
BSC/MIC
Sulfate Attack
Ion Penetration
Freeze-Thaw
Tree Root Intrusion

Biogenic Sulfide Corrosion, also referred to more broadly as Microbial Induced Corrosion (MIC), is
likely the most severe threat to concrete manholes. It is caused by certain bacteria that thrive in
sewer lines and manholes. This bacteria feeds on the untreated sewage and produces hydrogen sulfide
gas as a byproduct. The hydrogen sulfide gas is what causes the characteristic rotten egg smell that
often emanates from manholes. This gas reacts with moisture inside the manhole to form sulfuric
acid, which steadily corrodes the concrete surface.


It is estimated that Biogenic Sulfide Corrosion causes the average concrete manhole to lose over an
inch and a half of wall thickness from corrosion over the course of one decade. The United States
spends $14 billion a year combatting the effects of Biogenic Sulfide Corrosion.


[Click here to learn more about biogenic sulfide corrosion][12]

Sulfate attack occurs when sulfate ions from soil or groundwater penetrate concrete and react with
calcium compounds in the mix, resulting in the formation of gypsum crystals. These crystals grow and
expand over time, straining the surrounding concrete and ultimately resulting in a network of
cracks.


Sulfate Attack is especially dangerous in manholes, as the corrosion begins on the outside of the
manhole, which is not visible. Sulfate Attack can cause severe cracking, spalling, and surface
deterioration, that might remain undetected even with routine inspection until it results in massive
infiltration issues or catastrophic structural failure.


[Click here to learn more about sulfate attack][13]

Ion penetration has two different methods of damaging a concrete manhole depending on which ions are
involved. The most concerning type is chloride ion penetration. Chloride ions are prevalent in
coastal regions as well as anywhere that deicing salts. The chloride ions easily penetrate the
porous concrete and begin rusting the steel rebar. Rust, or iron oxide, is less dense than steel and
begins pushing outward on the surrounding concrete as it forms. This ultimately leads to spalling
and cracking which allows for infiltration and inflow issues as well as the possibility of
structural failure.


Calcium and magnesium ions are also a threat to manholes. They are less likely to interact directly
with the rebar, and more prone to reacting with the cement paste. This reaction weakens the binding
agent in the concrete, thereby reducing strength, and also expands as it does so, causing similar
issues as sulfate attack. However, this process is slower than sulfate attack or chloride ion
penetration, so it is unlikely to be the primary concern.


[Click here to learn more about ion penetration][14]

Freeze-thaw is a common threat to concrete structures exposed to freeze-thaw cycles, such as
manholes located in areas with a cold climate. When water freezes inside the pores of concrete, it
expands and exerts pressure on the surrounding material. When the ice thaws, the pressure is
released, and the concrete may crack or spall. The impacts of freeze thaw are obvious on the
roadways in the form of potholes, but the effects on the manholes just below the street are less
likely to be seen.


Even in areas with a relatively shallow frost line of around 36”, the cone of the manhole, which
bears much of the surface load, will be significantly impacted.

If a manhole has cracked even slightly from any of the before mentioned threats, it will be
susceptible to tree root intrusion. Tree roots will actively seek out the manhole as a source of
water and nutrients. The roots are able to enter though very small cracks and grow overtime causing
further cracking, joint separation, and even collapse of the manhole. In addition, the presence of
tree roots can create channels for water and other contaminants to enter the manhole, leading to
further deterioration.


If left unaddressed, the impact of tree root intrusion can be severe. The roots can result in
serious blockages, structural damage, reduced flow capacity, and contamination of the surrounding
soil and groundwater.

Use our [Concrete Manhole Lifespan Calculator][15] to estimate how long a manhole can withstand
these threats, and how much it will cost to k

Styrene Free

threats. P3 Polymers uses a custom formulated vinyl ester resin and a carefully designed blend of
inert mineral fillers so that our polymer concrete is as resilient as possible. We back all of this
up with our 50-year corrosion warranty.

 

The vinyl ester resin we use has a significantly higher resistance to chemical attack than the
industry standard polyester, and our aggregate blend features grains with the optimal size and shape
for an interlocking, high-strength matrix. Our polymer concrete is completely non-porous to
eliminate the risks of freeze-thaw or ion penetration, and the chemical resistance of the resin
entirely prevents biogenic sulfide corrosion.


[Click here to learn more about vinyl ester vs polyester resin][16]

durability. In compression, our polymer concrete exceeds 12,000 psi. That's roughly twice the
strength of a high-quality Portland cement concrete. We also achieve upwards of 4,000 psi in
flexural strength and 1,500 psi in tensile strength.

Biogenic Sulfide Corrosion, also referred to more broadly as Microbial Induced Corrosion (MIC), is
likely the most severe threat to concrete manholes. It is caused by certain bacteria that thrive in
sewer lines and manholes. This bacteria feeds on the untreated sewage and produces hydrogen sulfide
gas as a byproduct. The hydrogen sulfide gas is what causes the characteristic rotten egg smell that
often emanates from manholes. This gas reacts with moisture inside the manhole to form sulfuric
acid, which steadily corrodes the concrete surface.


It is estimated that Biogenic Sulfide Corrosion causes the average concrete manhole to lose over an
inch and a half of wall thickness from corrosion over the course of one decade. The United States
spends $14 billion a year combatting the effects of Biogenic Sulfide Corrosion.


[Click here to learn more about biogenic sulfide corrosion][12]

Sulfate attack occurs when sulfate ions from soil or groundwater penetrate concrete and react with
calcium compounds in the mix, resulting in the formation of gypsum crystals. These crystals grow and
expand over time, straining the surrounding concrete and ultimately resulting in a network of
cracks.


Sulfate Attack is especially dangerous in manholes, as the corrosion begins on the outside of the
manhole, which is not visible. Sulfate Attack can cause severe cracking, spalling, and surface
deterioration, that might remain undetected even with routine inspection until it results in massive
infiltration issues or catastrophic structural failure.


[Click here to learn more about sulfate attack][13]

involved. The most concerning type is chloride ion penetration. Chloride ions are prevalent in
coastal regions as well as anywhere that deicing salts. The chloride ions easily penetrate the
porous concrete and begin rusting the steel rebar. Rust, or iron oxide, is less dense than steel and
begins pushing outward on the surrounding concrete as it forms. This ultimately leads to spalling
and cracking which allows for infiltration and inflow issues as well as the possibility of
structural failure.


Calcium and magnesium ions are also a threat to manholes. They are less likely to interact directly
with the rebar, and more prone to reacting with the cement paste. This reaction weakens the binding
agent in the concrete, thereby reducing strength, and also expands as it does so, causing similar
issues as sulfate attack. However, this process is slower than sulfate attack or chloride ion
penetration, so it is unlikely to be the primary concern.

released, and the concrete may crack or spall. The impacts of freeze thaw are obvious on the
roadways in the form of potholes, but the effects on the manholes just below the street are less

Why Polymer Concrete

## Engineered for the toughest environments.

Polymer concrete is durable and chemical-resistant, lighter than traditional concrete, and sets fast
— ideal for demanding infrastructure, rapid construction and long-term reliability.

### Corrosion Proof

Resists chemicals, sewage gases and saline ground conditions that destroy ordinary concrete — no
rebar to rust, no degradation over time.

### 100% Waterproof

A dense, non-porous structure means zero water ingress or leakage — protecting networks and the
surrounding ground.

### 120 MPa Strength

Exceptional compressive strength with no steel reinforcement, delivering load-bearing performance at
a fraction of the weight.

### 1-Hour Curing

Rapid set time accelerates manufacturing and on-site installation, cutting project timelines
dramatically.

### Lightweight

Significantly lighter than precast concrete, simplifying transport, handling and installation on
constrained sites.

### 100+ Year Life

Built to last generations with minimal maintenance — a lower total cost of ownership across the
asset's lifetime.

## Renewable Carbon by nova-Institute

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

[Subscribe]

### Renewable Carbon Newsletters

Stay informed about the latest developments in the renewable carbon industry and nova-Institute’s
activities. Choose the news relevant to your business out of 19 different topics: sustainability –
renewable carbon – recycling – policy – pharma – natural fibres – food – engineering – energy –
digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –
plastics and composites – bio-based chemicals and industrial biotechnology – automotive –
agriculture, forestry and resources – nova’s monthly newsletter – Renewable Carbon Newsletter –
Press releases – events and conferences.

[**https://renewable-carbon.eu/newsletters**][38]

[Businesses Directory]

### ReCaCo – International Directory for Renewable Materials

The leading business directory for the bio-based, CO2-based and recycled materials gives you the
opportunity to look up suppliers, partners and service providers or present your own company and
products to the right audience for you.

[https://renewable-carbon.eu/companies/][39]

[nova-Institute]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

## Renewable Carbon by nova-Institute

Welcome to www.renewable-carbon.eu, the website showcasing nova-Institute’s many services around
renewable carbon: the bio- and CO2-based economy as well as chemical recycling. nova-Institute is a
science-based research and consultancy company. Organiser of leading expert conferences, workshops
and webinars.

[Subscribe]

### Renewable Carbon Newsletters

Stay informed about the latest developments in the renewable carbon industry and nova-Institute’s
activities. Choose the news relevant to your business out of 19 different topics: sustainability –
renewable carbon – recycling – policy – pharma – natural fibres – food – engineering – energy –
digital and artificial intelligence – carbon, capture and utilization – bio-based materials –
plastics and composites – bio-based chemicals and industrial biotechnology – automotive –
agriculture, forestry and resources – nova’s monthly newsletter – Renewable Carbon Newsletter –
Press releases – events and conferences.

[**https://renewable-carbon.eu/newsletters**][38]

[Businesses Directory]

### ReCaCo – International Directory for Renewable Materials

The leading business directory for the bio-based, CO2-based and recycled materials gives you the
opportunity to look up suppliers, partners and service providers or present your own company and
products to the right audience for you.

[https://renewable-carbon.eu/companies/][39]

[nova-Institute]

### nova-Institute

nova-Institut GmbH has been working in the field of sustainability since the mid-1990s and today
focuses primarily on the areas of circular economy, bioeconomy and CO2 utilisation. 

The independent company supports the chemical and plastics industries in the transition from fossil
to renewable carbon – based on biomass, CO2 utilisation or recycling – through research and
science-based consulting. 

Both in accompanying research for innovation projects and in individual business consulting, nova’s
interdisciplinary team covers the entire value chain. It works on all topics from raw materials,
technology scouting and market research to economics, policy, life cycle assessments and
sustainability, as well as support in communication and strategy development.
50 experts from different fields work together to defossilise the industry and create a
climate-neutral future.

[**www.nova-institute.eu**][40]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Renewable Carbon]

### Renewable Carbon

What is renewable carbon?

Renewable Carbon entails all carbon sources that avoid or substitute the use of any additional
fossil carbon from the geosphere. Renewable carbon can come from the biosphere, atmosphere or
technosphere – but not from the geosphere. Renewable carbon circulates between biosphere, atmosphere
or technosphere, creating a carbon circular economy.

How does it differ from the bioeconomy and circular economy? This page provides a definition and
background on the renewable carbon strategy and why it is relevant to you.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/info**][41]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Events]

### Renewable Carbon Events

nova-Institute hosts workshops and conferences, big and small, for an expert audience. Some related
to our research projects, some as stand-alone events. Most notable the Renewable Materials
Conference ([www.renewable-materials.eu][42]), International Conference on Cellulose Fibres
([www.cellulose-fibres.eu][43]), Conference on CO2-based Fuels and Chemicals
([www.co2-chemistry.eu][44]) and the nova Sessions, a series of workshops on pressing political
issues and market developments. On this website, you can find all upcoming events.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/events**][45]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Publications]

### Renewable Carbon Publications

nova-Institute is not only part of many research projects putting out valuable information on
bio-based and CO2-based chemicals, building blocks, polymers and materials as well as chemical
recycling topics, we also publish additional reports and background papers on policy, markets &
trends as well as technologies around the renewable circular economy.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/publications**][46]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu Graphics]

### Renewable Carbon Graphics

We firmly believe in making knowledge accessible: not only do we offer free reports to spread
knowledge on renewable carbon-related topics, but we also supplement the written word with
attractive graphics.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/graphics**][47]

[21 01 07 RC Diamanten Menu News]

### Renewable Carbon News

Relevant press releases, interviews and general news keep you informed about the latest innovations,
inventions, investments and developments in bioeconomy, industrial biotechnology, bio-based
chemistry and materials, CO2-based materials, Carbon Capture & Utilisation (CCU) and Power-to-X
industries as well as chemical recycling. Keep up easily with the latest research and market
developments by subscribing to the daily newsletter, Twitter account or RSS feed.

[**www.renewable-carbon.eu/news**][48]

# RockHardscp® POLYMER CONCRETE MANHOLES
# A LIFETIME SOLUTION!

**IMAGINE, PRECAST POLYMER CONCRETE MANHOLES HAVING A LIFE EXPECTANCY OF 300+ YEARS? ****…IT’S
TRUE! **

Conventional concrete corrodes in sanitary sewers and other challenging applications, requiring
costly repairs and replacement. RockHardscp® polymer concrete structures last for centuries and
deliver 100% corrosion protection. It’s time to “set it and forget it.”
[Switch to RockHard Today][12]

## What Is RockHardscp®?

RockHardscp® (SolidCast Polymer Technology, LLC) is industry’s longest-lasting polymer concrete
material-of-construction. It can be used to produce both precast and cast-in-place structures such
as precast manholes, wetwells, and other sanitary sewer containment structures, as well as…
* Tunnel segments
* Chemical containment structures
* Grouts and mortars
* And more!

## RockHardscp® Benefits

Anything worth doing is worth doing right. When you choose RockHardscp®, you’re investing in the
material-of-construction that gives you the peace of mind it will not fail structurally or
chemically. Unlike conventional concrete or even other polymer concretes, RockHardscp® needs no
liners, no coatings, nor any other “thin-skin” barriers to be…

✔ corrosion-resistant ✔ strong
✔ lightweight ✔ durable ✔ impermeable
✔ fast-curing ✔ environmentally friendly

## About Solidcast Polymer Technology

Since 1985, SolidCast Polymer Technology has been the premier producer of precast polymer concrete
technology for the wastewater industry and other sectors in markets all over the world. In addition
to RockHardscp®, we are the creator and manufacturer of QOR-TEQ^{tm}, the patented structural
enhancement solution.
[Learn More About Us][13]

### Products

Whether you need precast manholes or other precast structures, cast-in-place, or rehabilitations,
RockHardscp® polymer concrete is the product of choice, no matter the industry.
[Explore Products][14]

### Technology

RockHardscp® is formulated, designed, and engineered as an environmentally friendly, low carbon
footprint, no Portland cement material-of-construction with unmatched corrosion resistance,
impermeability, strength, and value.
[Discover the RockHardscp® Difference][15]

### Manufacturing

We are proud to have our licensed precast manufacturing plants ISO-9001 certified for quality
management, VOC- and HAP-free, and Made in the USA.
[Learn More About RockHardscp® Manufacturing][16]

### Services

In addition to our precast and cast-in-place products, SCP offers “cradle-to-grave” polymer concrete
engineering and design, construction, and technical services.
[See What We Can Do][17]

# RockHardscp® POLYMER CONCRETE MANHOLES
# A LIFETIME SOLUTION!

**IMAGINE, PRECAST POLYMER CONCRETE MANHOLES HAVING A LIFE EXPECTANCY OF 300+ YEARS? ****…IT’S
TRUE! **

Conventional concrete corrodes in sanitary sewers and other challenging applications, requiring
costly repairs and replacement. RockHardscp® polymer concrete structures last for centuries and
deliver 100% corrosion protection. It’s time to “set it and forget it.”
[Switch to RockHard Today][12]

## What Is RockHardscp®?

RockHardscp® (SolidCast Polymer Technology, LLC) is industry’s longest-lasting polymer concrete
material-of-construction. It can be used to produce both precast and cast-in-place structures such
as precast manholes, wetwells, and other sanitary sewer containment structures, as well as…
* Tunnel segments
* Chemical containment structures
* Grouts and mortars
* And more!

## RockHardscp® Benefits

Anything worth doing is worth doing right. When you choose RockHardscp®, you’re investing in the
material-of-construction that gives you the peace of mind it will not fail structurally or
chemically. Unlike conventional concrete or even other polymer concretes, RockHardscp® needs no
liners, no coatings, nor any other “thin-skin” barriers to be…

✔ corrosion-resistant ✔ strong
✔ lightweight ✔ durable ✔ impermeable
✔ fast-curing ✔ environmentally friendly

## About Solidcast Polymer Technology

Since 1985, SolidCast Polymer Technology has been the premier producer of precast polymer concrete
technology for the wastewater industry and other sectors in markets all over the world. In addition
to RockHardscp®, we are the creator and manufacturer of QOR-TEQ^{tm}, the patented structural
enhancement solution.
[Learn More About Us][13]

### Products

Whether you need precast manholes or other precast structures, cast-in-place, or rehabilitations,
RockHardscp® polymer concrete is the product of choice, no matter the industry.
[Explore Products][14]

### Technology

RockHardscp® is formulated, designed, and engineered as an environmentally friendly, low carbon
footprint, no Portland cement material-of-construction with unmatched corrosion resistance,
impermeability, strength, and value.
[Discover the RockHardscp® Difference][15]

### Manufacturing

We are proud to have our licensed precast manufacturing plants ISO-9001 certified for quality
management, VOC- and HAP-free, and Made in the USA.
[Learn More About RockHardscp® Manufacturing][16]

### Services

In addition to our precast and cast-in-place products, SCP offers “cradle-to-grave” polymer concrete
engineering and design, construction, and technical services.
[See What We Can Do][17]

## GREETINGS

Welcome to SPS Corporate, an Indonesian holding company dedicated to meeting the needs of our
customers through constant innovation and improvement.

## ABOUT US

As a company, SPS Corporate have always been dedicated to our vision and prioritized meeting the
needs of our customers and constantly improving the quality of our products and services. We aim to
establish strategic partnerships to ensure the sustainability for each of our affiliated companies.


Our paper businesses in Indonesia trace their roots back to 1973 when Mr. Suparsono founded PT
Surabaya Mekabox (SMB Group). Over the course of more than two decades of growth and consolidation,
we have become a prominent paper producer in Indonesia.

Today, we manage a diverse group of respected companies specializing in tissue, paper and packaging
manufacturing; construction material manufacturing; property development; and energy for power
supply.

## Our **Vision** & Mission

To build a global corporation that continuously grows through God’s favor, leaves legacy and be the
channel of blessing for the stakeholders

Developing competency in Human Capital by placing the right person in the right place at the right
time and building the right attitudes and striving spirit in all levels of positions through
continuous training and results driven culture

Pursuing excellence through innovative adopting newest technology and efficient production
management in order to achieve consistent satisfactory quality, create value added product and
deliver the best services

Building a long term fruitful partnerships with all company’s stakeholder

[José Luis Berné]
José Luis Berné
Director Adjunto y Responsable de Operaciones en el Circuito de Navarra
PROYECTO:
[Sistema de drenaje ULMA en el Circuito de Navarra][50]
"Los elementos de evacuación de agua en un **circuito de velocidad** son esenciales para mantener la
pista segura cuando llueve. **Gracias a estos sistemas de drenaje, se mejora la seguridad** y se

solución que se adopte  en proyecto"

Arquitecto en Castelló Arquitectos

> A battery system includes: a battery pack including a battery housing and a plurality of battery
